slug: 2025-10-07 Sierra Leone Turns to AI to Modernize Public Services

facts.fact: Sierra Leone signed an MoU with Qhala during the 80th UN General Assembly to train civil servants to apply AI in their daily work, with a first phase targeting 500 trainees.
